summary: Important: skopeo security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The skopeo command lets you inspect images from container image registries, get images and image layers, and use signatures to create and verify files.   

Security Fix(es):  

  * net: golang: Go net package: Denial of Service via long CNAME response in LookupCNAME (CVE-2026-33811)
  * docker: Moby/Docker Engine: Arbitrary Code Execution via malicious container image and compressed archive upload (CVE-2026-41567)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * Update skopeo to 1.22.2 [rhel-9.9] (JIRA:RHEL-170520)
  * update to the latest upstream release (JIRA:RHEL-185740)
  * switch skopeo to sustaining-engineering GitLab release-1.22 branch and bump epoch (JIRA:RHEL-220456)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.  

Additional Changes:  

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the AlmaLinux 9 Release Notes linked from the References section.
